choice_prompt:5:1711130003.text: Mmm! This tastes really good. I never imagined I'd actually improve the overall living standards of the fox clan in the capital. That's wonderful!
choice_prompt:5:1711130003.source_cn: 唔！味道真不错。真没想到，我居然还拉动了王都狐狸一族的整体生活水平。真是好事啊！

say:6:1711130004:1.text: I've been working tirelessly for Savannah all along; you just don't understand how hard I've worked.
say:6:1711130004:1.source_cn: 我可是一直在为赛凡纳操劳，是你不理解我的辛苦。

say:8:1711130008:1.text: But what brings you here to see me, fox? It can't be just to offer me some food, can it?
say:8:1711130008:1.source_cn: 不过，你来找本狐是有什么事吗？总不能是为了献上点美食吧？

choice_prompt:9:1711130008.text: But what brings you here to see me, fox? It can't be just to offer me some food, can it?
choice_prompt:9:1711130008.source_cn: 不过，你来找本狐是有什么事吗？总不能是为了献上点美食吧？

say:10:1711130009:1.text: Oh? It seems you've gone to see the Queen.
say:10:1711130009:1.source_cn: 哦？看来你去见过王后了。

say:12:1711130011:1.text: Let me think about where I should begin—
say:12:1711130011:1.source_cn: 让我想想，究竟该从何说起比较好——

say:14:1711130012:1.text: I heard the bells... It's time.
say:14:1711130012:1.source_cn: 我听见了钟声……是时候了。

say:15:1711130013:1.text: Roland, on this long journey to our destined day, we finally stand side by side here.
say:15:1711130013:1.source_cn: 罗兰，在这条通往命定之日的漫长征途中，我们终于并肩立于此地。

say:18:1711130016:1.text: He is a mortal with warm flesh and blood, who bleeds and gets tired.
say:18:1711130016:1.source_cn: 而是一个有着温热血肉、会流血、也会感到疲惫的凡人。

say:21:1711130019:1.text: Very good, Roland. This is precisely the most dazzling glimmer of humanity.
say:21:1711130019:1.source_cn: 很好，罗兰。这正是人类最耀眼的微光。

say:27:1711130024:1.text: I, Roland Augusta, hereby swear to the goddess of life—
say:27:1711130024:1.source_cn: 我，罗兰·奥古斯塔，在此向生命女神起誓——

say:29:1711130026:1.text: As long as this sword remains unbroken, the flame of Esperia's life will never be extinguished!
say:29:1711130026:1.source_cn: 只要此剑不断，伊索米亚的生命之火，便永不熄灭！

say:30:1711130027:0.text: So go and fight, defeat those shadows of the abyss!
say:30:1711130027:0.source_cn: 那么，去战斗吧，击败那些深渊之影！

choice:9:1:2.text: Why did you go to see Mordrine?
choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 你为什么去找了莫德琳？

choice:5:0:1.text: Can you be serious for once...?

say:32:1711130006:1.text: Even if I can survive without food, I still respect appetite.
say:32:1711130006:1.source_cn: 就算不需要食物也能维持存在，但我仍然尊重食欲。

say:33:1711130007:1.text: Food is a microcosm of human civilization; eating reminds me of my original identity.
say:33:1711130007:1.source_cn: 美食可是人类文明的缩影，吃东西会让我铭记自己原本的身份。

choice:5:1:2.text: You still have the appetite to eat!
